moodys.citation_text: Moody's Investors Service affirmed its 'A1' rating on Sioux Falls, S.D.-based Sanford Health's rated revenue bonds, affecting approximately $717 million of debt. The outlook is stable.

sp.citation_text: S&P A+ inferred from Becker's strong-finance compilations; specific S&P press release not retrieved.
sp.verification_note: S&P rating not directly verified; Sanford appears in Becker's strong-finance lists. Marking LOW confidence.

fitch.citation_text: Sanford Health has an 'AA-' IDR and revenue bond rating from Fitch, reflecting leading inpatient market share in multiple markets and strong financial profile. As of August 2024 Fitch report.

rating_actions_in_window.action_detail: Fitch affirmed Sanford Health at AA- with stable outlook
rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Strong financial profile; leading market share; not dependent on any single area
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Sanford has a AA- rating with a stable financial outlook, according to Fitch as of August 2024.

moodys.citation_text: A1 stable carried forward; no further Moody's action found in window.

sp.citation_text: S&P A+ carried forward; no S&P rating action found in window.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch AA- stable per August 2024 affirmation.

outcome_class_rationale: All three agencies affirmed Sanford Health at the same ratings entering and exiting the window (Moody's A1, S&P A+ inferred, Fitch AA-). No rating or outlook changes found in trade press for 2023-2025-Q1. Note: Sanford-Marshfield merger occurred during window; Fitch affirmed Sanford post-merger August 2024.
